repairedFindings.reason: The controller derives one stable publication key per semantic attempt and requires the publication gate to expose publishIdempotent(); concurrent terminal CAS losers converge on the winning terminal head.
ExecutionAttemptTransition records observedHeadRevision and fresh reconstruction derives/validates revision continuity from the immutable transition history.

findings.statement: The production organization lifecycle guard does not fence lifecycle currentness through canonical publication commit.
findings.reason: withOrganizationClaimGuard delegates to optimistic store.transact(), whose mutator/action runs before the successor CAS. Another lifecycle transaction may commit during publishIdempotent(); the guard can discover the conflict only after the publication side effect. The focused test uses serialGuard() instead of the production Blackboard transaction protocol and therefore masks this race.
requiredRepair: introduce a real lifecycle currentness fence shared by claim lifecycle mutation and authoritative publication commit, or an equivalent conditional publication protocol that prevents authoritative side effects after lifecycle currentness changes
add a race/integration test using the actual Blackboard store, ApplicationOrchestrator and OrganizationWorkClaimController rather than the serialGuard fixture
preserve current write-authority fencing and idempotent publication semantics
